title: I’m leaving home for a while + a little update on me
en: hello everyone i just wanted to give you a little bit of an update because i'm going to be leaving home for a little bit the air quality over here has been really bad and there's so much haze and just smog in the air and it's been pretty hard to tolerate i'm usually fairly tolerant i've been here a few summers either visiting or living here and we've had smoke before and i've gotten through it pretty well but this summer it's been different because it's been so close to home and so i decided that with my boyfriend and i we would go to the west coast for a little bit and to distract ourselves a little bit from everything going on over here and get some fresh air which we both

really need he's a surveyor and he works outdoors so he's had to wear a really big mask for most of it and i can't imagine it's comfortable so i think we're both really going to enjoy having a bit of a break and getting the crisp sea air which i'm very excited for of course i wanted to give a little more of an update in this video since obviously it's it's a little bit different it's really hard to film out here with all the smoke so i did want to tell you guys a couple shenanigans i've been up to recently and that is i have been raising caterpillars being able to raise caterpillars um has been

a possibly one of the weirdest things i've done so far living here i will explain i will tell the story from the beginning my parents had guests over at their house and that night the porch light was left on and so that morning i went over there to visit because it was during the heatwave and i was coming over a lot to enjoy the ac and so i noticed that a what i believe is a one-eyed sphinx moth was uh at the door and was right under the lamp and looked very exhausted she had been very distracted by the light that had been left on and she had also been heavily pregnant and so she had left all these little

eggs on a windowsill nearby i felt really bad because moss like that should leave their eggs on trees for example the sphinx moths eat willow leaves and so she if she hadn't been distracted by the light she would have probably flown to a nearby willow tree and had her babies there the eggs from the moth have a residue on them that makes them stick to anything they come in contact with and so it would be really tricky to remove them from the windowsill and move them to a willow tree without breaking most of the eggs so what i did was i put fresh willow leaves around the eggs waiting for them to be born and then i had about 60 caterpillars

after about a week or two and they were all climbing all over the windowsill and i didn't know what to do with them so i ended up just putting them in a big jar with a bunch of willow leaves so they could eat the leaves while the other caterpillars were being born one percent of baby caterpillars actually make it to adulthood and that's because the majority of them feed birds and feed other creatures and it's a very important part of nature's life cycle and so i went and i put a bunch in the trees and i just kept two because i thought it would be really great to take some photographs of the caterpillars and show the whole process

of the caterpillars transforming into moths to my former students because they're really interested in that whole life process and they're always so curious and none of them as far as i know have had the opportunity to witness caterpillars transform and so i wanted to do that as well anyway i hope to share with you an update on the caterpillar situation and also i will be sharing with you next week some highlights hopefully from my little trip and i appreciate you watching this all the way through if you've lasted this long because i clearly didn't have a plan for this video but i still wanted to share at least something with you last but not least i wanted to follow

the rest of this video with a little clip of one of the songs that my brother recently composed he's a very talented musician he recently made a lullaby that i've been listening to and it has brought me so much comfort during this strange strange time in the valley and i i really wanted to share this because i just thought it was beautiful so i hope you enjoy it and if you want to get updates on him you can of course follow him on instagram and get in contact with him but anyway i hope you have a wonderful day and you enjoy the music goodbye

zh: 大家好，我只是想向大家通报一些最新情况，因为我要离开家一段时间，这里的空气质量非常糟糕，空气中有太多的雾霾，而且空气中只有烟雾，这很难忍受。我通常相当宽容，我已经在这里待了几个夏天，无论是来这里旅游还是住在这里，我们以前也抽烟过，我已经很好地度过了，但今年夏天情况有所不同，因为它离家很近，所以我决定和我男朋友一起去西海岸呆一会儿，分散一下自己对这里发生的一切的注意力，呼吸新鲜空气，我们俩都可以呼吸新鲜空气。
真的需要他是一名测量员，而且他在户外工作，所以他大部分时间都必须戴一个很大的面具，我无法想象它会舒服，所以我想我们都会很享受休息一下，呼吸新鲜的海洋空气，我对此感到非常兴奋，当然我想在这个视频中提供更多更新，因为显然它有点不同，在这里拍摄真的很难带着这么多的烟雾，所以我想告诉你们我最近一直在做一些恶作剧，那就是我一直在饲养毛毛虫能够饲养毛毛虫嗯一直是
这可能是我迄今为止住在这里做过的最奇怪的事情之一，我会解释一下，我将从一开始就讲述这个故事，我父母在他们的房子里接待了客人，那天晚上门廊的灯还亮着，所以那天早上我去那里参观，因为当时正值热浪，我经常过来享受空调，所以我注意到一只我认为是单眼狮身人面像飞蛾就在门口，就在灯下，看起来很疲惫，她很心烦意乱通过一直亮着的灯，她也已经怀孕了，所以她留下了所有这些小东西
附近窗台上的鸡蛋我感觉很糟糕，因为像这样的苔藓应该把卵留在树上，例如狮身人面像飞蛾吃柳叶，所以如果她没有被光线分散注意力，她可能会飞到附近的一棵柳树上，在那里生下她的孩子。飞蛾的卵上有残留物，使它们粘在它们接触到的任何东西上，所以把它们从窗台上移到柳树上而不打破大部分卵是非常棘手的所以我所做的就是把新鲜的柳叶放在鸡蛋周围等待它们出生，然后我就有了大约 60 条毛毛虫
大约一两周后，它们都爬满了窗台，我不知道该怎么处理它们，所以我最后只是把它们放在一个装有一堆柳叶的大罐子里，这样它们就可以在其他毛毛虫出生的时候吃树叶。百分之一的毛毛虫宝宝实际上能活到成年，那是因为它们中的大多数喂养鸟类和其他生物，这是大自然生命周期的一个非常重要的部分，所以我去了，我把一堆毛毛虫放在树上，然后我只保留了两张，因为我觉得拍一些毛毛虫的照片并展示整个过程真的很棒

对我以前的学生来说，毛毛虫变成飞蛾的过程是因为他们对整个生命过程非常感兴趣，而且总是很好奇，据我所知，他们中没有人有机会亲眼目睹毛毛虫的转变，所以我也想这样做，无论如何，我希望与你们分享毛毛虫情况的最新情况，而且我将在下周与你们分享我的小旅行中的一些希望亮点，如果你们坚持了这么长时间，我很感谢你们一路观看，因为我清楚没有制作此视频的计划，但我仍然想最后至少与您分享一些内容，但并非最不重要的是我想关注
这个视频的其余部分是我哥哥最近创作的一首歌曲的一个小片段，他是一位非常有才华的音乐家，他最近制作了一首摇篮曲，我一直在听，在山谷里这个奇怪的奇怪的时间里，它给我带来了很多安慰，我真的很想分享这个，因为我只是觉得它很美丽，所以我希望你喜欢它，如果你想了解他的最新动态，你当然可以在 Instagram 上关注他并与他联系，但无论如何，我希望你有一个美好的一天，你喜欢音乐再见
